main.description: Trigger on-demand LLM chart analysis for a given week and source. Backed by chartAnalyze.bpmn (ADR-0056 BPMN-as-actor). Useful for back-filling historical weeks or re-analyzing after new vertex_game_title data arrives.

weekStart.description: ISO date string for the Monday of the target week, e.g. '2026-04-27'.

analysisUri.description: AT URI (vertex_id) of the created vertex_game_chart_analysis row.

socialText.description: Japanese social post text (≤300 chars) summarizing the chart trends.
